messages:
amanda: Quick question — we have a change that flips a non-critical feature flag default (opt-out for a telemetry flag). Do we treat this as a patch bump or a minor? :thinking:
raj: If it's purely internal telemetry and doesn't change any public API/behavior, I lean patch. Patch = bugfix/config-only.
ben: Agree mostly, but watch for observable behavior changes. If switching the default could alter integrations or user-visible metrics, that could be a minor.
amanda: It's an internal metric that only the infra team reads, not surfaced in the API. No schema changes.
raj: Then patch. Also: do we include buildmeta on the tag for the deploy window? e.g. `v1.12.3+telemetry.20240321` to make it clear it's a non-functional toggle change.
ben: I like `+meta` for clarity. Keeps semver consumers intact while making hotfix provenance obvious.
releasebot: releasebot: created tag `v1.12.3+telemetry.20240321` for commit abcdef1 and queued for the 22:00 change window. :robot_face:
amanda: Thanks — will update release notes. What minimal note do we need for a patch-only toggle?
raj: One-liner: "Change default for internal telemetry flag (opt-out). No API or behavior change for external users." Link to the PR.
ben: And add a short rollback criterion: "If error rate increases by X% or metric Y drops by Z within one deploy hour, rollback." Keeps SRE playbook actionable.
amanda: Good point. Also, should we pin the config on Dedicated customers? We have customers on dedicated that rely on the old default.
raj: For Dedicated, we treat defaults as customer-impacting. Either coordinate a custom rollout or mark as minor for the dedicated branch and schedule a customer notice.
ben: So summary: hosted => patch + buildmeta tag + release note + rollback thresholds. Dedicated => coordinate/opt-in or minor with notice.
amanda: I'll draft release note and add the rollback checks to the deploy checklist. tagging convention for future: `v{M}.{m}.{p}+<intent>.<yyyymmdd>`?
raj: yeah, something like `v2.0.1+telemetry.20240201` or `+hotfix.1` for backports. Keep `+` metadata stable for internal searches.
ben: One more ops consideration: deploybot should annotate the rollout with the metadata so console traces can filter by `+telemetry`. Could we add that to the deploybot payload?
releasebot: releasebot: noted — if tag contains `+`, sending tag_meta="telemetry" to rollout API. Will include in next deploy run.
amanda: Perfect. I'll post the PR link and finalize notes. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
